description: Posts a comment to a specific commit in a GitLab project repository. Use this action when you need to provide feedback, review notes, or discussion on a particular commit. Line-specific comments require both path and line parameters; if invalid, the comment is placed at the commit level.

line.description: The line number where the comment should be placed. Requires path to be specified.
line.title: Line

line_type.description: The type of line ('new' or 'old'). Requires path and line to be specified.
line_type.title: Line Type

note.description: The text content of the comment.
note.title: Note

path.description: The file path relative to the repository. Required if line or line_type is specified.
path.title: Path

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

sha.description: The commit hash or name of a repository branch or tag.
sha.title: Sha

name: create_commit_comment

avatar_url.description: The URL of the author's avatar.
avatar_url.title: Avatar Url

id.description: The ID of the comment author.
id.title: Id

name.description: The name of the comment author.
name.title: Name

state.description: The state of the user account.
state.title: State

username.description: The username of the comment author.
username.title: Username

web_url.description: The URL to the author's profile.
web_url.title: Web Url

created_at.description: The timestamp when the comment was created.
created_at.title: Created At
